frequency_question: How often do central bank principals who possess the legal capability to activate a countercyclical capital buffer choose to raise it above 0% during periods of financial stability expansions within a two-year horizon?
membership_rule: Major jurisdictions (e.g., UK FPC, Bank of Canada, RBA, ECB/Eurozone national authorities, Federal Reserve) operating a CCyB framework between 2010 and 2026. Excluded: jurisdictions without an active operational CCyB framework or where authority rests outside the central bank.

cases.name: Reserve Bank of New Zealand activation

coverage_note: 5 hits out of 7 major peering jurisdiction policy cycles where authorities had active frameworks.
known_gaps: Excludes minor emerging market implementations with shallow historical data.
validity_reason: Macroprudential frameworks remain stable over multi-year horizons barring major legislative overhauls.
